comments.body: suggestion (low): ⚪ **Paginated jq picks a last region per page** **(non-blocking)** `--paginate --jq` runs per page, so `last` prints one `ui` region per matching page. Past 100 comments the reader can get two and parse the older verdict (executed). ```bash gh api "repos/$RESOLVED_REPO/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments?per_page=100" --paginate --slurp \ | SHA="$HEAD_SHA" jq -r 'add | [.[] | select(.body | startswith("")) | .body | capture("(?[\\s\\S]*?)").r // empty | select(contains("head `" + env.SHA[0:7]))] | last // empty' ``` `pr-reviewer` · commit `0819a4f`
